# A source-owned jsontext import must survive splitting generated streaming
# methods into their own companion. Native and upstream results must match.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2
env CGO_ENABLED=0

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^\{"Schema":\{"ok":true\}\}$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/jsontextstruct

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
    jt "encoding/json/jsontext"
    "encoding/json/v2"
    "fmt"
)

type Payload struct { Schema jt.Value }

func main() {
    data, err := json.Marshal(Payload{Schema: jt.Value(`{"ok":true}`)})
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    fmt.Println(string(data))
}
